y_0 not a ramification point of q
objects: bielliptic double cover of an elliptic curve

finding.statement: A non-primitive degree-four pencil factoring through a smooth genus-one intermediate curve can have balanced Casnati-Ekedahl splitting F cong O(4)+O(5). For every elliptic Y, every P in Pic^2(Y), every M in Pic^5(Y) whose unique point y_0 with O(y_0) cong M tensor P^{-2} is not a ramification point of q=phi_{|P|}, and every reduced B in |M^{tensor 2}|, the double cover psi:C->Y branched along B is a smooth connected genus-six curve and gamma=q o psi is finite flat of degree four with E cong O(2)+O(3)+O(4) and F cong O(4)+O(5), once (CE) and (N) are imported by the FND-0150-sanctioned pair CE 1996 Theorem 2.1 and SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6. Such data exist. Consequently primitivity of gamma is not a property of the balanced locus, and the residual question of FND-0104 is answered affirmatively for intermediate genus one. The argument does not treat intermediate genus two or three, does not assert that a connected component of a balanced base can be purely of type (ii), and does not compute the exact monodromy image inside S_2 wr S_3.
